description: Review summary for one Airbnb listing (by room id or URL): overall guest rating out of 5 and number of reviews, the six category ratings (cleanliness, accuracy, check-in, communication, location, value), share of 5/4/3/2/1-star reviews, review themes with mention counts (e.g. 'Hot tub' 165), Guest favourite and Superhost flags, host's total review count. Individual review texts are not included (Airbnb does not put them in the public page). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
